notes.title: Masters of Death + Other Changes
notes.content:
Hi all! A new update has been recently added to the game. This has been live for a while, but it seems we forgot to post an update, so here it is now:

[h2]Masters of Death DLC[/h2]

3 mysterious ronin have travelled over from Japan and set up camp in a shrine in the desert, waiting to challenge the brave and the foolish alike.

This DLC character/level pack contains new characters, each with their own fighting styles and special moves:

[b]Arashi:[/b] Summons a small storm cloud that fires lightning at nearby enemies and can stun enemies on impact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/60639c695fa15f5830ce71b411fad019f2c14b5b.png[/img]

[b]Homura:[/b] Summons a ring of fire that can set nearby enemies ablaze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/8be8280aab980017058a5f787fe6b20389a5e960.png[/img]

[b]Kinzoku: [/b]Summons a line of spears that emerge from the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/e1313ef04bd20a6b7179a40bf60b5fc3f41ce38b.png[/img]

Face the Masters of Death in a new level: [b]The Desolate Desert[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/bc85a6e7c455cf436d7df485d02230c51ac51671.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/49b9a4856efd341d846c6e2b12133365db72d66a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/65775816ed9e5a8c63c4e600dd62e2426def92e8.png[/img]

Buy from the Steam page and the new level and characters will appear in your single player campaign (& other modes) as well as multiplayer.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[list][*] Kicks have been adjusted to feel more reliable and powerful. This should be the case for full body tracking users as well as regular players.
[*] If you are moving in your playspace, thumbstick movement will be reduced/disabled until you stop moving.
[*] Auto lowers height if calibrated so that you are floating off the floor.
[*] Added a "Character intro" option to the Mirror/Spectate view to zoom in on the opponent at the start of a round.
[*] New CPU vs CPU (single) Mode - Choose 2 characters and a location to watch a custom fight.
[*] Heads and feet now less wobbly on knockout.
[*] Nerf to Fan Lin's shadow hands.
[*] Multiplayer: Kicking player and switching host now take a few seconds and can be cancelled by pressing the button again.
[*] Multiplayer: Can now add players as favorites, which will highlight games with your favorites in making it easier to play with people you like.
[*] Multiplayer: Can now view a list of players in a game.
[*] Fix: Water at dragon temple will now put out fire.
[*] Extra Icon for Discord senseis.
[*] Adjusted special modes > single fight to choose characters via the main menu, instead of character select room.
[*] Increased the amount of enemies spawning in Co-op, Halloween special.
[*] Fix to enemy spawn position in co-op, Vertigo.
[*] Ip Ming-yu's Speed hands special move: Will receive less damage and knockback while doing it.
[*] Multiplayer: Fix to not being able to mute yourself.
[*] Some tweaks changed to auto muting of toxic chat.
[*] Adjustment to health bars for characters with >100% health.[/list]

+ from the previous update:

[list][*] Multiplayer: Default walk speed during a fight has been slowed down. This should help with some lag issues & hopefully make the general multiplayer fight experience better. You can still set it back to "Faster" in room settings.
[*] Multiplayer: Custom PvP Mode - Can change some settings for PvP to fine tune your experience.
[*] Multiplayer: New soccer pitches: Night and Rainy.
[*] Multiplayer: New speed by distance option "Speed By Distance Effect" - if you like speed by distance but find it a bit too severe, you can adjust it with this option.
[*] Fingertip Nerf: A change to reduce damage from accidental finger strikes/finger flicks. Intentional spear hand strikes will still do the same damage.
[*] Fixes to rigging on Ling Hou and Mingxia.
[*] Fixed random host swapping.
[*] Fix to muting not always working.
[*] Change to spawning locations in levels in multiplayer.
[*] Discord icon added to button + button added to multiplayer rules.
[*] Multiplayer: Added "Quit to Main menu" button on initial character choosing menu.
[*] Multiplayer: Fix to mouths sometimes not moving when players talk.[/list]

[h2]Future Roadmap[/h2]

We're nearing 5 years of development on this game now, but there is still more to do:

[list][*] A character editor that we are excited about, should be ready for beta testing before too long.
[*] More character/level DLC packs. Next one should be ready for late March, and intend to do at least 1 more after that.
[*] Further down the line we plan to add a weapons mode with at least 27 weapons to use, but this is a big project so will take a bit of time.
[*] Will continue to try and improve the game physics and the multiplayer experience.[/list]

notes.title: Crossplay is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Steam/Meta Crossplay[/h2]

You can now play multiplayer against players using meta quest devices. (This was soft launched a couple of weeks ago to double check that it didn't cause any issues)

[h2]Other recent changes:[/h2]

[h3]Move speed[/h3]

Can now adjust move speed in multiplayer to change focus from thumbstick movement more toward real life movement. Can set to slow, slower or By Distance - where it gets slower when you get near to an opponent. This can also help with issues due to lag/latency

[h3]PvP Options[/h3]

Can now have realism or stamina mode fights in PvP. Realism means no special moves, no slow motion and reduced UI elements. Stamina Mode means 5x health

[h3]Other Changes/Fixes/Tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] Anti Lie Down now only activates is you stay low for an extended period of time, so it shouldn't kick in if ducking low etc
[*] Can now use the Ninja Dojo as a PvP arena
[*] Implemented : A 3rd party moderation tool to assist in keeping a positive community experience.
[*] Lots of smaller bug fixes & tweaks
[/list]

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

We are working on the following features:

[list]
[*] Some DLC character/map packs
[*] A character creator
[*] A weapons mode (will take some time)
[*] Some improvements to make spamming less viable vs actual technique
[/list]

We don't have any ETAs for these yet, but join the discord to participate in beta testing of these features soon

notes.title: Shaolin Soccer Mode - Now in Dragon Fist!
notes.content:
[h1]Shaolin Soccer: Multiplayer Kung Fu Madness is now in Dragon Fist: VR Kung Fu[/h1]

🔥 [b]Get Ready for Kung Fu Chaos![/b]
Explore Shaolin Soccer, where the intense, physics-based combat of Dragon Fist: VR Kung Fu meets a wild west version of soccer with no rules! Fight in unpredictable, action-packed matches to see who's the best, worst, soccer team! 

🧨 [b]About Shaolin Soccer:[/b]
Imagine playing soccer with a twist of kung fu madness. Choose between Team Yin and Team Yang in 2v2 or 1v1 matches. Use your martial arts skills to attack, defend, and score goals.

Unleash special moves and perks, blending offense and defense in spectacular ways. From throwing dynamite to popping the ball, creativity and chaos rule this field.

The objective is simple: score five goals to win. But with martial arts in the mix, nothing is straightforward. Use your kung fu prowess to dominate the field and outsmart your opponents in the stupidest ways possibile.

🔑 [b]Key Features:[/b]
⦾ Choose Your Team: Play in teams of 2v2 or 1v1, selecting between Team Yin and Team Yang.
⦾ Attack and Defend: Engage in thrilling matches with dynamic combat and swift maneuvers.
⦾ Unleash Special Moves: Use unique abilities to gain an edge and create spectacular gameplay moments.
⦾ Score Five Goals: Be the first team to reach five goals, blending strategy and skill.

[h2]If you'd like to help us Beta Test Crossplay between Steam and Quest, join our Discord![/h2]

🌐 [b]Connect with Us:[/b]
⦾ Join our Discord: http://dragonfistvr.com/discord

⦾ Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dragonfistvr

⦾ Visit our Website: http://dragonfistvr.com

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 - Graphics Overhaul, Multiplayer
notes.content:
Hi All,

Its been a while, but behind the scenes we have been working hard for the last year, and can now announce the next chapter in Dragon Fist: VR Kung Fu, Version 2.0.0....

[previewyoutube=Kit5hZxuMI8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Graphics Overhaul[/h2]

Environment artists and character artists have given the whole game a complete graphics overhaul, with pretty much every inch redone, but with the environments and characters retaining their existing personalities

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

Can have up to 8 players in a game, but with only up to 4 characters fighting at once:

Featuring:
[list]
[*] Versus Modes - Modes designed to be 1v1, but in arcade etc, spectators swap in to play after each knockout
[*] Co-op Modes - can play the single player campaign, except 2v2 with a friend by your side. Also arcade mode, ninja challenge, halloween special and vertigo
[*] More than 2 Modes - Modes designed for, well... more than 2 players. Free for all, Team Fight (2v2), Arcade. Or the Halloween special where 1 player is human and the rest are undead!
[/list]
Come and join out official discord to find people to play with and discuss the game: [url=https://discord.com/invite/qn4zFNh22M]https://discord.com/invite/qn4zFNh22M[/url]

[h2]New Original Score[/h2]

Replacing the stock music from before, each level has now had its own original piece of music to help immerse you in the world of dragon fist

[h2]New character bios[/h2]

All characters text has been thoroughly gone over and improved

[h2]+ More![/h2]

Loads of smaller changes, too many to list + We will continue to add more things down the line and continue to try and improve the multiplayer and general dragon fist experience!

Here's a small preview of things we are planning/considering:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/d55db36d0c3b9571e5d7d213af3aaacba596323c.png[/img]

Thanks to all who have supported the game this far!

notes.title: Halloween Special + More
notes.content:
So you are used to fighting Kung Fu masters and ninjas, but maybe were wondering: When will I get to fight against the Undead?

Well now you can in the new "Halloween Special" game mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/86177c07f9ccdc44075a7a624d3ea1eafcbbb722.gif[/img]

The Jiangshi are based on chinese folklore and are kind of a cross between Vampires and Zombies, and have been seen in some Kung Fu movies including "Mr Vampire" (1985). Pressure points have different effects against them and occasionally you will encounter a zombified version of one of the normal game characters...

Also, if you want to play as a zombified character, that is also now available in Custom Game mode - pick Undead mode from the options.

Other Recent Changes:

[list]
[*] Single Fight Mode - (Special Modes > Single Round Modes). You can use this to just have a single battle against a character. Can pick your character, opponent, and location, or have them random. You can also pick the amount of opponents
[*] Quick next fight. In any of the normal modes, when you have won a fight, you can hold down the dash button to quickly go to the "next" fight. You can also make this happen automatically via options > Advanced. The "next" fight is determined by the game looking for the easiest unlocked character with the fewest stars
[*] Other fixes to do with the completionist achievement, some special moves not breaking the master difficulty block
[*] Been preparing some new fun content behind the scenes
[/list]

notes.title: Vertigo Mode & LIV Support
notes.content:
[h1]Vertigo Mode:[/h1]

A new Single round game mode where you will fight opponents on a raised platform. All opponents will have full health, but you can quickly beat them by knocking them off the edge, while trying to stay on the platform yourself of course. There are some small platforms you can jump to with a few throwing weapons to assist you.

I think this is a fun addition as it requires different tactics to the normal game and the height factor adds a bit of jeopardy.

To unlock it you have to have landed 10 flying kicks throughout your dragon fist career. The special modes menu will show you how many you've got

[h1]LIV support[/h1]

There were quite a few requests for this early on, but Ive always been a bit unsure about how it would fit with the game, but thanks to some help from the LIV team, it is in game and working now. Supports Mixed reality and Avatars to allow you to do some fun things to put in your videos/streams...

Heres me experimenting with it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/c6427000151d2f1db5767ce6065841377dacd0af.gif[/img]

But better results can be achieved via green screen I believe (i must get one...) but im impressed with its ability to remove the background via AI.

Here is a clip of King Cosmotron playing using a scorpion avatar: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/SxWBQHMRjqM

[h1]In progress[/h1]

Have been laying down the groundwork for some other fun things in future. Including new characters and levels. Hopefully a character editor and hopefully multiplayer (to be confirmed). I'm excited to be doing some new content for the game. Let me know if there's a character/scene you would like to see, but try to keep it (at least loosely) within the theme of the game - chinese kung fu movies, or maybe more broadly: martial arts movies

[h1]Other changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Main menu calibration - will now pop up and tell you the size its worked out for you and allow you to go to advanced calibrate from there. This is just to make it clearer whether its worked or not and allow you to change as I know some people have had trouble
[*] Custom safety circle size - can fine tune the size of the safety circle in the advanced calibrate room
[*] Can now smash the mirror
[*] Some improvements to the Training chambers to make it clearer what you have to do
[*] Some minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: CPU vs CPU + Quest 2 Version
notes.content:
[h1]CPU vs CPU:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/2eb1b078d92bff8a3dce74af00da08f92fc2303a.gif[/img]

A few people have said they enjoyed watching the guys fighting on the main menu and wanted more of that, so I added a special mode where you will be presented with a random fight and can try to predict who will win. I think its quite a fun little extra thing. I don't intend to add much more to this feature besides a leaderboard as I think I should be working on other things closer to the main core of the game.

[h1]Quest 2 Version:[/h1]

If you've been holding off on the steam version because you would prefer a wireless experience (and dont want to use Air link) then you can now get the game natively on the quest: https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5075285115918784

There are some visual downgrades from the PC version, but the game is largely the same.

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]

Along side that, a few minor changes:

Changed calibration to also take arm length into account which will hopefully work better for those with long arms (or short legs)
New game mode icons + new menu layout for special modes - let me know if its clear or confusing
Throwing wine bottle or pistol at opponents now hurts them
Spectate button can now be set to "Toggle" as well as Enabled/Disabled from before
Some fixes todo with grabbing daggers etc with left hand and some things to do with left handed mode
A some extra options added to the menu: Toggle Ambient Sound, can switch off hit effects
Can now smash the mirror in the level select room
Have updated the Demo

notes.title: Full Body Tracking + New Music
notes.content:
[h1]Full Body Tracking is here![/h1]

I've wanted to add this from the start because I think if any game is a good fit for FBT it is Dragon Fist VR, and it was a fun, but difficulty thing to add. I wanted it to feel like a proper part of the game, not just an afterthought.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/adfaba13bd82b165c8810ef078e805f4777a2b50.gif[/img]

To make it work you need 2 or 3 vive trackers (other options are available, but Ive only used vive trackers). 1 for each foot and an optional one for the waist. But also you need a setup that will support these trackers i.e. one some base stations/lighthouses

Here is a page describing how to setup the trackers to work with the game: http://www.benoldinggames.co.uk/Dragon-Fist-VR-Full-Body-Tracking-Setup.htm

....or Here is a video tutorial on how to set it up:

[previewyoutube=AuIq8ZBOU_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Once setup, you will be able to kick and will unlock a special "Full Body Training" room, with some stuff to kick in

Make sure you warm up first! and keep all pets, children and ming vases well clear. Also consider using the safety circle to help keep you in the middle of your playspace.

[h2]New Music[/h2]

Thanks to composer Leonard RR Cox, the game now has a main theme and some other more subtle tracks for some of the non combat sections (choosing level etc).

The main theme was inspired by an iconic song from kung fu cinema and I imagine aficionados will already guess from that (no, not 'kung fu fighting'!) and I think really fits with the game

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Custom Game - "Slo Mode" changed. Have changed this so that your special meter is replaced by a slow mo meter that decreases as your slow mo runs out. Is charged the same way as a special move. Makes the game much easier, but its pretty satisfying to fight in slow motion
[*]Advanced Calibrate - Can now also adjust the floor height, but I would recommend you set it up properly outside the game if you can.
[*]Lin Yong now has a voice and will encourage you in the practice room
[*][spoiler]Characters on secret levels now have voices[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Cheats will now be remembers between sessions and it will ask you on start up whether to keep them on + a couple more options added to "Enemy Hinder"[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Advanced Calibrate + a few other surprises...
notes.content:
[h2]Advanced Calibration Room[/h2]

I have added a new room that can be accessed via a button the level select screen. In this room you can manually adjust your height, as well as arm length and controller alignment. This is so that you can get your character to more accurately match your body proportions if you so wish. I think I will also add a floor height option at a later time.

[h3]Safety Circle[/h3]

This is an experimental feature, so use at your own risk...

I know that in the heat of battle, sometimes the steam guardian or oculus/meta guardian can sometimes not be enough to stop you hitting a wall etc, so this feature will place a circle in the middle of your playspace to help keep you in the middle and will get more intrusive to closer to the edge of it that you get. There is also an option to just have a circle (less obnoxious), and to also show arrows to keep you facing forward.

If you use this, please make sure you have plenty of arm swinging space when in the circle and also note: if using a quest 2 that it can move the steam centre if you switch it on/off. Can use the recentre option in steam to bring it back in line.

[h3]New Mini Game: Punching Pad[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/5b2fc0b238c6081c37bbf7f9bbd9206f6fa9d4be.gif[/img]

Just a small thing, basically a game of whack-a-mole that you can play at the shaolin temple. Hit as many of the targets as you can within 30 seconds. Let me know if you have any other minigame ideas!

[h3]bHaptics[/h3]

Now in addition to the Tactsuit (Vest), Tactal (Face) and Tactosy for feet, there is now also support for Tactosy for arms to help you feel blocks and strikes on your arms. I also added a few more effects to the feet for foot based special moves

[h3]Virtual Fighting Championship[/h3]

In case you missed it: DFVR is in a bundle with another VR fighting game called Virtual Fighting Championship which features multiplayer. Check it out

[h3]New Secret Level[/h3]

notes.title: Left Handed Mode, bHaptics Vest Support, New Pressure Points
notes.content:
Hi All,

Have just put up a new version (and new version of the Demo) with a few changes:

[h2]bHaptics Support: Tactsuit (Vest), Tactal (Face), Tactosy (Feet)[/h2]

This is a fun addition for anyone lucky enough to own some bHaptics gear: You will be able to feel hits aswell as various other effects: The special moves often have different vibration effects, the healing wine one is my favourite I think, and you feel the shaolin finger jab go right through you. Also of course you can feel where you get hit as well as how hard which can be useful tactically as well as adding to immersion.

The feet are more for preparation for the full body tracking which is still a work in progress, but if you use them now you will be able to feel footsteps and the kick impacts. I intend to do a bit more work on the feet to make the impacts more directional.

To use any of the above, just have them switched on when you start the game. Note: Will also work in the demo

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Left Handed Mode - for all your southpaws out there: you can engage left handed mode by holding left trigger on the main menu for a few seconds, or via the options menu. It reversed the hands of the controls e.g. right thumbstick moves you instead of left, laser pointer gets swapped, special moves swap sides so that you can throw ninja stars etc with your left hand instead of right. There is also an option to have right handed controls, buy with left handed special moves.
[*] After its been requested a few times, I have added pressure points to the kidneys as well as the back of the neck. To be honest I find them quite hard to hit, which is why I didn't add them originally, but that may be just down to how I play the game. The back of the neck does double damage and weakens them for a few seconds, whereas the kidneys cause extra 'pain' damage over time. Check them out in the practice room
[*] Made some things clearer in the training chambers
[*] Increased the snap turn angle - adjust this to your liking by changing 'turn speed' in the options menu
[*] Added a sound volume option
[*] Fixed a bug where Ting An's special was sometimes adding more "Can't walk" than it should have + I added a hand vibration effect if you try to walk while you cant, which should make it more obvious whats going on.
[*]New Cheat Mode: [spoiler] Big Heads, its a bit silly but quite fun - ask me on discord if you want to know how to access cheats. https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/885835362935668746/949403838077612062/unknown.png[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed an occasional error with the level picking screen when starting a new game
[*]Updated the demo
[*]Other small fixes
[/list]

[h2]FAQs:[/h2]

Quest version and Full body tracking still work in progress

[h2]Thanks:[/h2]

Thanks again to everyone who has bought the game and/or given encouraging comments, it is appreciated. If you want to come and chat about dragon fist, the discord is here: https://discord.com/invite/mQTws3m5FU

notes.title: Mirrors, Gongs and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215399/1f67da286299b10ea39abb70908b364b59a3d86f.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Improved saving/loading hopefully made it more reliable for those who were having issues. If you still have problems, please get in touch via discord or email: ben@benolding.co.uk
[*] Mirror in the level select/practice/general room - the reflection is a bit smaller than real life, and it looks like it comes out the mirror a bit, but I've enjoyed posing in it, feels strange looking in a mirror and seeing someone else look back

[/list]

[h2]In other news....[/h2]

The Quest 2 version is coming along nicely, it plays/feels pretty similar to the steam game and I'm getting it to look pretty similar to, with a few bits that had to be cut back. There are currently a few bits in the game where it drops frame rate a bit: certain levels and especially if there is more than 1 opponent. I'm also not quite happy with the general colour of the game on quest. But progress is being made. I don't know when it will be released or whether it will be accepted by the oculus store or applab. But if interested come and join the discord and/or follow my youtube for updates.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mQTws3m5FU
YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvRirW8kZg-GAcRvd-uDp9g

Full Body Tracking: Its been difficult, but am making decent progress: Ive managed to get it matching my legs quite well and able to turn out knees etc + made the feet stick to the floor a bit so that you don't get them going through the floor or wobbling. This also meant making a more advanced calibration where you can adjust arm length and leg length, so that might also be useful with the normal game.

Thanks for the ideas suggested. I do think I will put in kidney pressure points, and maybe back of the neck. I think I will also try adding double press direction for dash.

[h2]Thanks[/h2]

Thanks for the nice reviews and the continued enthusiasm, as well as the excellent videos and streams people have done, it really helps

notes.title: Version 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hello all, I've just put a new version up today, here are the main features:

[h2]Mirror View Options[/h2]

This is what ive been working on most this past couple of weeks and I am pretty pleased with the result. If you go to the options menu > mirror view. You have some settings there that will affect what appears on your computer screen (but not what you see on your headset). Its worth noting that having something different rendering can affect performance a bit, so if it feels slow, switch it off if not needed, or reduce quality a bit.

[list]
[*] POV FOV - increase the field of view when in POV view
[*] POV Stabilize - smooth out the wobbling you see when watching VR footage
[*] Mirror Mode - Choose between: POV, Mixed, Moving, Side view, Behind View, Enemy POV, Static, Mixed will switch between the mode, hopefully showing on screen something that will resemble a fight scene out of a movie (your mileage may vary)
[*] Mini POV - show the stabilized POV camera at the bottom left of the screen while other modes are showing in the main view
[/list]

(See the video at the bottom of the post)

A note with this: If you press the spectate button while a non POV view is showing, then the mirror camera will move to line up with your own and zoom in a bit - I did this so that if you want to talk to camera or do some cool pose or something, then you know that the "viewer" will be seeing something similar to you.

Its not perfect yet (sometimes goes behind a wall, the zoomed in spectate cam button still seems to be a bit wobbly) but I think its pretty fun and I wanted to get it out there - I will continue to work on it

[h2]Realism Mode[/h2]

Some people expressed a desire to have a way to do some more realistic martial arts fights without special moves etc. So I have added "Realism Mode" to the special modes on the main menu. It has:

[list]
[*] No special move
[*] No slow motion
[*] Less effects e.g. no stars flying round their head when dazed. You will still get hit effects
[*] Minimal UI - no healthbars, combo text etc flying about
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Special move positions now a bit more forgiving
[*] Healing wine nerfed a bit
[*] Fixed a glitch on the Pimax and some WMR headsets that sometimes turned you round 180 degrees
[*] Extra options for custom mode (switch U to minimal, switch off slow mo)
[*] Few other small things
[*] Tried to do a thing to make your character mouth move when you talk, but I don't think its working - let me know if you see it
[/list]

I've got some vive trackers that I hope to experiment with over the weekend (should be fun), and next week I hope to try and add a left handed mode and try a few other things that I mentioned in my last post + things that players have suggested.

I hope you like the new changes! and have a great weekend - Ben

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you all![/h1]

Very pleased with the reviews, comments and videos Ive been seeing. Thank you so much. Its been a test of endurance making this game, and there's always more that could be done - so its such a relief to see people enjoying it.

[h3]Demo[/h3]

For those that haven't got the game yet, I will be releasing a playable demo tomorrow featuring the training chambers and 2 opponents: Ling Hou & Onochi Takahashi

[h3]Valve index controller adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Now Detects fist based on finger positions rather than the amount of squeeze, so loose fists will now activate pressure points and get you through the chambers
[*] Mr Timothy's move will now be activated properly by trigger
[*] Moved the spectate button to B on the left controller to prevent accidental pressing when making fists. This replaces the quit/abandon fight shortcut, so use the pause menu to abandon instead
[/list]

[h3]Other changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Calibration adjustments you will now be a bit bigger relative to your character so that arms will be a bit more outstretched when yours are, and your character will stand up straighter if you are. Let me know if you get any issues with short arms or standing on tip toes
[*] Seated mode now available. Access via Options > VR in the options menu
[*] Chi ball adjusted, now can launch it early by pushing forwards while its generating. But can still use the old volleyball technique if you generate it fully in front of your face. Also fixed an issue where it bounced off sometimes.
[*] The full marks achievement should now work ok
[*] Some minor errors fixed
[/list]

[h3]Plans:[/h3]

Here are some things I am thinking about for the near future that people have requested (or based on suggestions) + a few things I am thinking about. No promises for any of it other than I intend to look into doing them...

[list]
[*] Oculus/Meta quest standalone version (95% done)
[*] Full body/leg tracking - I hope to get some trackers in the new year
[*] Bigger wrists - I know some of the wrists are thin an some people find that un-immersive, so I will see if I can make them a bit more realistic
[*] "Realism mode"? was thinking of a mode without specials, slow mo and dashes. For those who are after a more realistic game. Custom mode covers a lot already, but maybe Realism could be available earlier - its an idea in progress
[*] More stuff for youtubers/streamers - I might see if I can get the mouth moving when you talk, I might look into LIV support, and I might allow you to put your logo or something on a noticeboard
[*] Spectator view and/or stabilised mirror view on screen
[*] Maybe sneak in the one armed boxers and/or kurayami as opponents somewhere, maybe like a bonus/hidden round
[*] Longer Term I want to try multiplayer both PvP and Coop, but don't know until I try whether it will work nicely with the physics and fast page
[*] I have some other ideas that I will keep to myself for now but think could be great
[/list]
